svg.title: Ask Abu Dhabi agent trace
svg.desc: Animated example of one request. A visitor asks for a two-day family beach trip. The agent runs check_moderation, search_attractions, search_dining, calculate_distance_to_place, search_itineraries and select_cards_to_display, streams a two-day plan with three place cards over SSE, and sends the trace to Langfuse and Phoenix.

g.text: 2 days in Abu Dhabi with the kids.
We love beaches. Can you plan it?
Day 1, Saadiyat. Louvre Abu Dhabi in the
morning, lunch by the water, then the
Day 2, Yas Island. Warner Bros. World,
then Yas Waterworld in the afternoon.
Streaming answer to the widget over SSE
Trace sent to Langfuse and Phoenix
